newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lundbergs says sells Ostgota bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Lundbergs says sells Ostgota bank stake.

text.p: Swedish holding company Lundbergs said on Monday it had sold its shares in Ostgota Enskilda Bank, corresponding to a 76.9 percent stake, to Danish bank Den Danske Bank for 50.50 crowns each.
Lundbergs said in a statement that Den Danske Bank has also offered to acquire the rest of the shares in Ostgota Enskilda bank on the same conditions as it bought Lundbergs' shares.
"Den Danske Bank's acquisition of Lundberg's shares in OEB is conditional on approval from the financial authorities," Lundbergs said in a statement.
The purchase relates to 43.3 million shares with a total purchase price of about 2.2 billion crowns.
Lundbergs said the sale would give the company a capital gain of about 1.4 billion crowns.
Lundbergs has been the main shareholder in OEB since the middle of the 1980s.
"During this time Lundbergs has been an active owner developing OEB into a provincial banking group in southern and central Sweden," the statement said.
Lundbergs said it would use the funds gained from the sale to invest further in Swedish industry.
